summary: Corrected the verify question's timing premise instead of leaving a vague one on record. The account had attributed the successor-overlap condition to a stall or to an 'ElectionTimeout - LeaderLeaseTimeout' window; reading the loops shows ElectionTimeout only governs a candidate's retry, a follower actually campaigns after HeartbeatTimeout without leader contact (randomized to [H, 2H)), and the leader's lease check runs every max(10ms, LeaderLeaseTimeout - maxDiff). Under the documented defaults the leader leaves office ~500ms before the earliest campaign, so the windows cannot overlap; they can only touch when LeaderLeaseTimeout == HeartbeatTimeout, which ValidateConfig permits, where the boundary comparison diff <= leaseTimeout plus the 10ms check floor open an exposure of about 10ms plus the election itself. I added five source ranges, recorded the trigger semantics as @follower_election_trigger_semantics for reuse, and rewrote the limitation and the gap answer accordingly (gap still unresolved, requiring a boundary probe or a leader-side stall). The question's evidence, executions and defect claim are unchanged; no execution was requested this turn. Also read the heartbeat fast-path contract and the staged-commit-index path without finding a defect.
